## Load in Libraries and Data

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: hide

# Load in required libraries
library(tidyverse) # Data manipulation and visualization
library(here) # File path management
library(terra) # Raster data processing
library(stars) # Spatiotemporal array
library(sf) # Spatial data handling
library(tmap) # Thematic mapping


# Load in Night Lights data
# Read in each .tif for each date
light_feb_07_h5 <- read_stars(here(
  "data",
  "VNP46A1",
  "VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif"
))
light_feb_07_h6 <- read_stars(here(
  "data",
  "VNP46A1",
  "VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif"
))
light_feb_16_h5 <- read_stars(here(
  "data",
  "VNP46A1",
  "VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif"
))
light_feb_16_h6 <- read_stars(here(
  "data",
  "VNP46A1",
  "VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif"
))


# Load in OpenStreetMap data
# SQL query to select only motorway
roads_query <- "SELECT * FROM gis_osm_roads_free_1 WHERE fclass='motorway'"

# Load in motorway data with query
highway <- st_read(
  here("data", "gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg"),
  query = roads_query,
  quiet = TRUE # ignore warning message
)


# Load in OpenStreetMap data
# SQL query to select only residential buildings
houses_query <- "SELECT *
                 FROM gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1
                 WHERE (type IS NULL AND name IS NULL)
                 OR type IN 
                 ('residential', 'apartments', 
                 'house', 'static_caravan', 'detached')"

# Load in residential data with query
houses <- st_read(
  here("data", "gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg"),
  query = houses_query,
  quiet = TRUE # ignore warning message
)
```



#### Transform Data to Match CRSs
```{r}
# Transform CRSs
highway <- st_transform(highway, crs = 3083)
houses <- st_transform(houses, crs = 3083)


# Run conditional to make sure transform worked
if (st_crs(highway) != st_crs(houses)) {
  warning(
    "Highways and houses have different CRS"
  )
}

# Verify CRSs match
st_crs(highway) == st_crs(houses)
```



## Comparing Night Light Intensities
```{r}
# Combine the two tiles for each date
pre_storm <- st_mosaic(light_feb_07_h5, light_feb_07_h6) # pre storm
post_storm <- st_mosaic(light_feb_16_h5, light_feb_16_h6) # during blackouts


# Create the bbox extent of Houston
houston_bbox <- st_bbox(
  c(xmin = -96.5, ymin = 29, xmax = -94.5, ymax = 30.5),
  crs = st_crs(pre_storm)
)


# Clip extent of the raster layers
pre_storm_houston <- st_crop(pre_storm, houston_bbox)
post_storm_houston <- st_crop(post_storm, houston_bbox)


# Mask unrealistic values (>1000 or <= 0)
masked_pre_storm <- pre_storm_houston
masked_pre_storm[(masked_pre_storm > 1000) | (masked_pre_storm <= 0)] <- NA

masked_post_storm <- post_storm_houston
masked_post_storm[(masked_post_storm > 1000) | (masked_post_storm <= 0)] <- NA


# Combine layers for mapping
combined_storm <- c(masked_pre_storm, masked_post_storm)


# Change names for better visualizations
names(combined_storm) <- c(
  "February 7, 2021 (Pre-Storm)",
  "February 16, 2021 (Post-Storm)"
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6

# Map of Night Lights Intensity Pre Storm

tm_shape(combined_storm) +

  tm_raster(
    col.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "Light Intensity (nW cm⁻² sr⁻¹)",
      orientation = "landscape",
      title.size = 0.7,
      text.size = 0.7
    ),
    col.scale = tm_scale(values = "inferno")
  ) +

  tm_facets(ncol = 2, free.scales = FALSE) +

  tm_graticules(
    col = "white",
    lwd = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.2,
    labels.size = 0.5,
    labels.pos = c("left", "bottom"),
    n.x = 4,
    n.y = 4
  ) +

  tm_layout(
    scale = 0.8,
    legend.position = tm_pos_out("center", "bottom"),
    legend.frame = TRUE,
    panels.labels = c(
      "February 7, 2021 (Pre-Storm)",
      "February 16, 2021 (Post-Storm)"
    ),
    panel.label.size = 1.0
  ) +

  tm_title(
    "Houston Night Light Intensities Before and After Winter Storm",
    size = 1.2
  )
```



## Create Blackout Mask

#### Reclassify the cells
```{r}
# Calculate difference (change) in night light intensity
light_diff <- rast(pre_storm) - rast(post_storm)


# Reclassify the cells and drop any less than 200 nW cm⁻²sr⁻¹
rcl <- matrix(
  c(
    -Inf,
    200,
    NA,
    200,
    Inf,
    1
  ),
  ncol = 3,
  byrow = TRUE
)

blackout_mask <- classify(light_diff, rcl = rcl)


# Vectorize the raster into polygons
blackout_vector <- st_as_stars(blackout_mask) |>
  st_as_sf() |>
  st_make_valid()


# Crop the polygon to Houston extent
houston_blackout <- st_crop(blackout_vector, houston_bbox) |>
  st_transform(crs = "EPSG:3083")
```

#### Verify CRS's
```{r}
# Run check to make sure houses matches houston CRS
if (st_crs(houston_blackout) != st_crs(houses)) {
  stop("Update CRSs so they match!")
}


# Run check to make sure highways matches houston CRS
if (st_crs(houston_blackout) != st_crs(highway)) {
  stop("Update CRSs so they match!")
}


# Verify
st_crs(houston_blackout) == st_crs(houses)
st_crs(houston_blackout) == st_crs(highway)
```

#### Exclude Highways from the Cropped Blackout Mask
```{r}
# Create a 200m buffer around highways
highway_buffer <- highway |>
  st_union() |>
  st_buffer(dist = 200)


# Remove highway buffers from blackout areas
blackout_no_highways <- st_difference(houston_blackout, highway_buffer)


# Identify buildings in blackout areas
blackout_homes <- st_intersection(houses, blackout_no_highways)

```

#### Identify Homes Likely Impacted by Blackouts
```{r}
# Filter the houses that relate to blackout area
houses_blackout <- houses |>
  st_filter(blackout_no_highways)

# Print the houses affected by blackout
n_houses <- nrow(houses_blackout)
```

There were approximately 157,408 houses that were affected by the blackout.

#### Improve data for mapping
```{r}
# Create points for mapping homes
all_homes <- st_centroid(houses)
not_impacted_homes <- all_homes[!all_homes$osm_id %in% blackout_homes$osm_id, ]
impacted_homes <- st_centroid(blackout_homes)
```

## Map of the Homes that Lost Power
```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6

tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap") +

  tm_shape(highway) +
  tm_lines(col = "darkgoldenrod1", lwd = 0.8) +

  tm_shape(not_impacted_homes) +
  tm_dots(fill = "chartreuse2", size = 0.01, fill_alpha = 0.3) +

  tm_shape(impacted_homes) +
  tm_dots(fill = "firebrick1", size = 0.01, fill_alpha = 0.5) +

  tm_add_legend(
    type = "symbols",
    labels = c("Power lost", "Power maintained"),
    fill = c("firebrick1", "chartreuse2"),
    shape = 21,
    size = 0.6,
    title = "Homes"
  ) +

  tm_title("Houston Homes Impacted by Feb 2021 Winter Storms") +

  tm_layout(
    legend.position = tm_pos_in("left", "top"),
    legend.bg.color = "white",
    legend.text.size = 0.6,
    legend.title.size = 0.8,
    legend.frame = TRUE
  ) +

  tm_add_legend(
    type = "lines",
    labels = "Major Highway",
    col = "darkgoldenrod1",
    lwd = 0.8
  ) +

  tm_scalebar(position = c("right", "bottom"), text.size = 0.5) +

  tm_compass(position = c("right", "top"), size = 1.5)
```


## Reflection

Comparing VIIRS night lights from February 7 and February 16, 2021 shows a widespread drop in light intensity across Houston after the winter storms. After identifying cells with a decrease greater than 200 nW cm⁻² sr⁻¹ and excluding areas within 200 m of highways, an estimated 157,408 homes lost power. This approach has several limitations. The 200 nW cm⁻² sr⁻¹ threshold is somewhat arbitrary, the comparison relies on only two cloud-free dates, and the coarse raster resolution means entire cells are labeled as blackouts. OpenStreetMap building data may also be incomplete and not have the correct building classification. Finally, this analysis does not examine whether impacts differed across socioeconomic groups.
